title: Micelle-like clusters in phase-separated Nanog condensates: A molecular simulation study.
authors: Mizutani, Azuki; Tan, Cheng; Sugita, Yuji; Takada, Shoji
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过残基级粗粒化分子模拟揭示转录因子Nanog相分离凝聚体中的胶束样簇结构及其与DNA的互作机制，高度契合TF-DNA互作与物理模拟方法课题。
abstract: The phase separation model for transcription suggests that transcription factors (TFs), coactivators, and RNA polymerases form biomolecular condensates around active gene loci and regulate transcription. However, the structural details of condensates remain elusive. In this study, for Nanog, a master TF in mammalian embryonic stem cells known to form protein condensates in vitro, we examined protein structures in the condensates using residue-level coarse-grained molecular simulations. Human Nanog formed micelle-like clusters in the condensate. In the micelle-like cluster, the C-terminal disordered domains, including the tryptophan repeat (WR) regions, interacted with each other near the cluster center primarily via hydrophobic interaction. In contrast, hydrophilic disordered N-terminal and DNA-binding domains were exposed on the surface of the clusters. Electrostatic attractions of these surface residues were responsible for bridging multiple micelle-like structures in the condensate. The micelle-like structure and condensate were dynamic and liquid-like. Mutation of tryptophan residues in the WR region which was implicated to be important for a Nanog function resulted in dissolution of the Nanog condensate. Finally, to examine the impact of Nanog cluster to DNA, we added DNA fragments to the Nanog condensate. Nanog DNA-binding domains exposed to the surface of the micelle-like cluster could recruit more than one DNA fragments, making DNA-DNA distance shorter.
abstract_zh: 转录的相分离模型表明，转录因子（TFs）、共激活因子和RNA聚合酶在活跃基因位点周围形成生物分子凝聚体并调控转录。然而，凝聚体的结构细节仍不清楚。在本研究中，针对Nanog——一种已知在体外形成蛋白质凝聚体的哺乳动物胚胎干细胞主转录因子——我们使用残基级粗粒化分子模拟检查了凝聚体中的蛋白质结构。人Nanog在凝聚体中形成胶束样簇。在胶束样簇中，C端无序结构域（包括色氨酸重复（WR）区域）主要通过疏水相互作用在簇中心附近相互结合。相反，亲水性的无序N端和DNA结合结构域暴露在簇表面。这些表面残基的静电吸引负责桥接凝聚体中的多个胶束样结构。胶束样结构和凝聚体是动态且类液体的。WR区域中色氨酸残基的突变（该区域被认为对Nanog功能重要）导致Nanog凝聚体解离。最后，为检查Nanog簇对DNA的影响，我们将DNA片段添加到Nanog凝聚体中。暴露在胶束样簇表面的Nanog DNA结合结构域能够招募多个DNA片段，使DNA-DNA距离缩短。
